Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Danni Wyatt and Tammy Beaumont will open the batting for England. Megan Schutt will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! The defending champions need 357 runs to chase the target and defend their title. They face a tough challenge ahead since they will be up against a strong bowling attack. The six-time world-champions, Australia Women do have an opportunity to lift the World Cup for the seventh time. Who will come out on top? We will find out. Stay tuned!

The bowlers failed to justify their skipper's decision to bowl first today. It's been a tough day so far for them in the field. They started off well by troubling the batters with some swing, but they could not manage an early breakthrough. They got their spinners on early as well, but they too failed to provide an early wicket. They gave away just 37 runs in the first Powerplay but leaked around 120 runs in the final 10 overs. They did drop two catches in the middle, had they taken those, things could have been slightly different for them. They grabbed a few wickets towards the end of the innings, but it was all too late for them. Anya Shrubsole was the pick of the bowlers she grabbed 3 wickets and gave away just 46 runs in her spell. It's on to the batters, they have to chase a huge total of 357 to retain their crown.

Not a bad toss to lose for Australia! Once again, the Australian openers, Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes gave Australia the desired start. They did start slowly but they accelerated the innings after the first Powerplay. They put together 160 runs and put England under immense pressure. Rachael Haynes perished after a fine knock of 68. But Mooney came in and she along with Healy put together over 150 runs and guided Australia over 300 runs. Alyssa Healy scored 170 runs and she certainly owned Hagley Oval today, she just kept on going and going. Anything and everything she touched turned to gold. Australia Women have just proved why they are the number one side.

Phew! We have witnessed one of the greatest batting shows today! It's been a scintillating performance from Australia Women. It was raining boundaries in Hagley Oval. We have been treated with some fine batting. Dominance from Australia with the bat continues. They have put a mammoth total of 356 on the board, and England Women can breathe a sigh of relief for now as their pain in the field is over but they have a mountain to climb from here on.

Commitment from Ellyse Perry! Full ball, on middle. Perry lifts it to long on and calls for a couple of runs. She has to run hard for the second run and makes the ground with a big dive. Australia Women end with a mammoth total of 356 for 5.
FOUR! Tell about finding the gap! Full and outside off. Perry opens the face of the bat in the last moment and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! 350 is here! Full ball, around off. Perry muscles it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off, slower. Perry slaps it to the right of deep cover for another couple of runs. Can they breach the 350 mark?
Darted on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side and they get a couple of runs.
A low full toss, angling on leg, McGrath heaves it to long on for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Australia Women trying to finish on a high! Fuller and outside off. McGrath jams it out through cover-point for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Perry wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
A flighted full toss, outside off, driven to covers where a misfield allows a single.
A full ball, tailing on the pads, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
Full ball, on middle, Perry works it to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Perry steers it straight to backward point.
This is full and around off. McGrath drives it aerially and to covers for a quick single.
Ellyse Perry comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A length ball, around off, was the slower one. Beth Mooney charges down the track and pulls it flat but there was no power on it and hence hits it straight in the hands of Natalie Sciver at deep mid-wicket. Anya Shrubsole is on a Hat-trick here...
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Anya Shrubsole

Commentary.Commentary: Tahlia McGrath walks out to bat at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Full ball, outside off. Meg Lanning tries to heave it but gets a leading edge, in the air and to short third man where Tammy Beaumont reverse-cups it over her head. Something to cheer in this innings for England.
Commentary.Howout: c Tammy Beaumont b Anya Shrubsole

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss, on middle, hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Yet another expensive over! Length ball, outside off. Lanning cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Easy, very easy! Length and down the leg side. Lanning gives a faint touch to it and helps it through short fine leg for a boundary.
Brunt continues to serve it short. Mooney hooks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again. Lanning gets tall as she pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women walks out to bat now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ashleigh Gardner looks out of her crease and yes the replay confirms the same. England trying to just minimize the damage from here on. Full and on off. Mooney drives it to long on and comes back for the second run but the throw from Kate Cross was brilliant and Anya Shrubsole does really well to clip the bails off. It is taken upstairs and the replay shows Ashleigh Gardner is out of her crease.
Full and on off. Gardner lofts it over covers for a single. Not off the middle but falls safely.
Flatter and on off, pushed to covers.
Ashleigh Gardner comes to the crease now.

OUT! STUMPING! What a knock! Take a bow, Alyssa Healy! The crowd is up on their feet as she walks back. Coming to the ball, This is full and outside off. Healy takes a step forward and looks to swing across the line but misses. Amy Jones, takes it and clips the bails off in a flash. No need to take it upstairs as Healy had her foot in the air. End of an incredible innings and what a time to notch it. She gets a standing ovation from the crowd and from the England supporters as well.
Commentary.Howout: st Amy Jones b Anya Shrubsole

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and outside off. Healy anticipates this one to angle in and she leaves it alone in the end.
Length ball, outside off. Mooney mistimes her heave to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker-length delivery, wide of off. Beth Mooney digs it out towards point for a single. 18 runs of the over!
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length. Beth Mooney misses her flick. Wide given!
Five wides! This is full and down the leg side. Mooney misses her flick. The keeper fumbles and it races away to the fence. It is not looking good for England.
Another short ball, outside off. Healy hops and tries to pull but gets a top edge and the ball drops safely towards the mid on region. A single.
Short ball, on middle. Mooney whacks it over the keeper, not off the middle but will get a single.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Fuller ball, outside off. Healy shuffles across and paddles it to short fine leg for a boundary. Beats the fielder comfortably.

FOUR! This is so easy for Alyssa Healy, clear the infield and bag a boundary! Full and on leg. Healy makes room and smashes it over covers for a boundary. She crosses 500 runs in this edition. 300 up for Australia Women.
Kate Cross is back on.
FOUR! Beth Mooney joins in as well! It's raining boundaries here! Fuller ball, outside off. Beth Mooney makes room and smashes it over cover for a boundary. 19 runs of the over!
Straighter on this occasion, around middle. Alyssa Healy knocks it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Make that three boundaries! This is some exceptional batting we have been treated to today, and it is not over! Another fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy makes room and lifts it over point this time for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Two in row! Streaky this time! Outside off, fuller ball. Alyssa Healy steps down and tries to go over cover, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Anything she touches turns into gold! Fuller ball, width on offer. Alyssa Healy lifts it over cover for a boundary. 150 up for Alyssa Healy!
A low full toss, around middle. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps this past point for a brace.
FOUR! Fourth boundary of the over and that is fifty for Beth Mooney! Back of a length, around middle. Beth Mooney shuffles across and pulls it towards square leg for a boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Three boundaries in a row now! This is just too easy for Alyssa Healy! A full toss, around middle. Alyssa Healy makes room, opens the face of her bat, and drives it over cover for a boundary.

FOUR! Up and just over! A fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy shuffles across, and paddle scoops this towards short fine leg. The fielder there backtracks and jumps to grab the ball, but the ball passes just above her hands towards the fence for a boundary.
FOUR! On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy makes room and slams it over cover for a boundary.
On a length, around middle and leg. Beth Mooney flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller again, around middle. Beth Mooney eases it down to long on for a single. That brings up the 100-run stand between these two!
Fuller ball, arround middle. Beth Mooney works it away towards long on and they take two runs!
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Beth Mooney misses her flick. Wide called!
Slower ball, loopy delivery, around middle and leg. Beth Mooney tucks it past square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Beth Mooney is enjoying herself as well! Lovely batting! Sophie Ecclestone drops it short now, outside off. Beth Mooney hangs back this time and cuts it past point for another boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Great use of her feet! A fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Beth Mooney shimmies down the pitch and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps it towards short third man and she scampers through to the other end.
Heather Knight brings her trump card Sophie Ecclestone back.
On a length, down the leg side. Beth Mooney backs away, and pulls it past mid-wicket. They take two runs comfortably.
Shorter ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This is just wonderful batting! A fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy makes room, and lifts it over the fielder at mid off. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Beth Mooney tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Much slower this time, full, on middle. Alyssa Healy drags it with the inner half of her bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point. Beth Mooney at the other end wanted a single, but she was sent back by Alyssa Healy.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! Bangs a bouncer, on middle. Healy stands tall as she tries to scoop it over the keeper but misses. The keeper is standing up so she collects the ball and clips the bails off quickly as she sees Healy lose her footing. The replay rolls out and Healy had her back foot in the air but it went down just at the right time.
There is a stumping chance. But, Alyssa Healy has got her back foot back in the crease on time. Not out says the third umpire!
Very full and on leg. Healy makes room and squeezes it out to backward point.
A single as this is hit to deep cover.
Pitches it up, on off. Healy mistimes her drive to long off. A single.
Length and outside off. Healy fails to scoop it away.

FOUR! How many times we have seen this now? No one at fine leg and still Brunt keeps on straying on the pads. Mooney just needs a faint touch as the ball races away to the fine leg fence. Katherine Brunt is disappointed with herself.
Short of a length and on off. Healy hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length, on middle, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Sees Beth Mooney shuffling across in her crease and brunt serves it way outside off, over the tramline. Mooney fails to dig it out.
Touch fuller and outside off. Healy swings across to deep mid-wicket for one run.
A length ball, on off. Healy backs away and strokes it to covers.
FOUR! Poor from Brunt! Too straight on the pads. Healy helps it away to the fine leg fence.

Angles a length ball, outside off, this one nips away after landing. Mooney takes a big stride forward as she looks to cut but misses. Amy Jones, behind the stumps clips the bails off and appeals. The replay shows there was no bat involved while Mooney had her back foot grounded. Not out it is.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mooney tries to drive this but misses.
On middle, Alyssa works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, around off, pushed straight to covers.
FOUR! Superb shot! A length ball, outside off. Healy steps across and paddles it past short fine leg for a boundary. Innovation at its best.
Healy missed out there! Fuller and down the leg side. She makes room as she shuffles on the leg side and looks to drive but misses.
Very full and angling on middle. Mooney pushes it off the inner half back to Shrubsole.
FOUR! Past the fielder! Length ball, outside off. Mooney creates room as she cuts it past the point fielder for yet another boundary,
Short ball, on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off. Mooney comes down the track and gets too near to the ball, ends up hitting back to the bowler.
Around off, on a length. Healy goes back on the leg side and cuts it to deep point for a run. The 50-run stand is up now.
Outside off, this is hit to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! WOW! Healy was waiting for her century as she is unleashing herself now. Overpitched and on off. Healy backs away and lifts it superbly over covers for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Mooney knocks it through covers for a single.
This is on a length and angling on middle from 'round the wicket. Mooney gets low and looks to scoop it but misses and gets hit on the body. An appeal for LBW but not given.
Length and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Has to be shot of the day! Gorgeous! Fuller and on middle. Healy makes room and drives it through covers for a boundary. Timed it really well.
Bangs a bouncer but on the slower side, on middle. Healy pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.

Four byes! Bonus runs! Australia won't mind it, they will take it with both hands. This is full and angling on leg, it nips away as well. Mooney looks to heave it but misses and the ball goes past the leg stump for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, Mooney drills it straight to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off. Mooney chops it to backward point.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off. Mooney pulls it, not quite of the middle but enough to clear the mid on fielder. A boundary.

THERE IT IS! She has done it once again! On a length ball, wide of off. Alyssa Healy cuts it past point for a single. Century for Alyssa Healy! Back-to-back hundreds for her! She just cannot stop scoring runs. Her teammates and the crowd at Hagley Oval are up on their feet applauding her knock! Alyssa Healy hugs Beth Mooney, removes her helmet, raises her bat, and celebrates her fifth ODI ton. A century in the final of a World Cup! What a knock this has been so far.
Full in length, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Full again, loopy delivery, on middle. Beth Mooney defends it out.
Fuller ball, tosses it up on middle. Beth Mooney blocks it out.
Full, slower through the air, around off. Beth Mooney steps down the track and drives it to cover.
Wide! Shorter, down the leg side. Beth Mooney misses her flick. Wide called!
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Alyssa Healy lunges and pushes it past cover for a single. She moves on to 99!
Tosses it up again, full, outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and blocks it out.
Loopy delivery, full, around off. Alyssa Healy defends it out.
Slower this time, on a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover for a single.
Much fuller now, wide of off. Beth Mooney drives it towards deep cover for a single.
On a length, outside off. Beth Mooney defends it out.
FOUR! WOW! Wonderful shot! Very short on this occasion, over the batters head. Beth Mooney hops, and upper cuts it towards third man for a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length. Beth Mooney misses her flick. Wide given!
Shorter now, wide of off. Beth Mooney chops it past point. Two taken!
Full, on middle. Alyssa Healy knocks it down to long on. Single taken!
Outside off, shorter in length. Alyssa Healy pushes it past over for a single. She moves to 96!
Shorter ball, flatter, around middle. Alyssa Healy defends it out.
Fuller ball again, around off, slower through the air. Beth Mooney steps down and drives it toward mid off for a single.
Loopy delivery now, full, around off. Alyssa Healy leans and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Shorter ball again, spinning in, outside off. Beth Mooney cuts it past point for a single.
Tad shoter, outside off, spinning away. Alyssa Healy pushes it past cover for a single.
Angling in on a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Play halted! Katherine Brunt seems to have hurt her shoulder while stopping the ball. The physio is out there to check on her and as a result, the umpires have called drinks! Australia Women still cruising along nicely, they might have lost one wicket, but they have plenty of batting still to come. England Women will be looking to capitalize on the wicket they have just got.

FOUR! A fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy shows the full face of her bat and drives it down the ground. Katherine Brunt runs to her right from long on, dives, but fails to stop the ball. Boundary! She seems to have hurt herself there! The physio is out to check on her.
Slower again, outside off, tad fuller. Alyssa Healy opens the face of her bat and guides it towards short third man.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Beth Mooney pushes it off the back foot past point. the fielder from third man will cut it out. Single taken!
Much slower this time, angling in, on middle on a length. Alyssa Healy tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it through cover for a single.
Floated and on off. Blocked out towards mid off. Finally, a successful over for England.
Fuller and outside off. Mooney leans and knocks it to covers for a quick single.
A loopy ball, around off. Mooney pushes with gentle hands to cover.
Flatter, quicker and around off. Healy pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Healy prods and defends it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! And finally, England Women have a break! Sophie Ecclestone comes into the attack and strikes! A sigh of relief for England. A fuller ball, around middle, slower through the air. Rachael Haynes shimmies down the pitch and tries to go cover, but ends up slicing it towards backward point. Tammy Beaumont there takes an easy catch. Australia Women have lost their first wicket. Beth Mooney comes to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Tammy Beaumont b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Sophie Ecclestone (4-0-20-0) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Short of a length, on off, this is pulled away to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball, angling around middle. Haynes flicks it more off the inner half of the bat to fine leg. A single.
Touch short and on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, on a length. Healy makes room and pokes it to point.
A length ball, around off. Haynes backs away as she pushes it uppishly but fails to get it past point. Will only get a single.
On the pads. Healy wrists it to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish and outside off. Haynes drives it to short cover where the fielder dives to her left and makes a good stop.
Short of a length and on off. Healy rides the bounce as she pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A slower full ball, outside off. Healy guides it to point. Was from the back of the hand. England need to use more variation and tricks.
Length ball, drifting on middle. Haynes makes room and punches it to deep point for a single.
Short ball, angling on middle. Haynes sits under it. Amy Jones, the keeper is standing up as well.
Shorter and outside off. Healy slaps it to deep cover for a single. 150 up for Australia Women.
Tad fuller, outside off. Rachael Haynes defends it out towards point.
Flatter ball, full in length outside off. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Rachael Haynes steps down and lifts it over the fielder at mid off. The ball will not go all the way but the batters pick up two runs!
Short and outside off, Haynes cuts it to point.
Quicker ball this time, full again, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Australia Women are on the charge! Tosses it up, full, around middle. Alyssa Healy shimmies down the pitch and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Short and on the pads. Haynes pulls it to fine leg for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Length ball, on middle, Healy flicks it to square leg for a quick single.
FOUR! Boundaries are coming easily now! This is on a length and on the pads. Healy tickles it with perfect timing to fine leg for a boundary.
Slants a length ball, slower and on the pads. Haynes hits it to square leg for a run.
Fuller ball, on middle. Healy flicks it to mid-wicket where the fielder gets a hand on it and the batters will only get a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes steps down the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter now, around middle. Alyssa Healy swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A full toss, around off. Alyssa Healy shimmies down the pitch and smashes it over cover for another boundary.
Wide! Fuller ball, wide of off. Alyssa Healy looks to reverse-sweep this but she misses. Wide called!
FOUR! Up and just over the fielder at mid off! Tosses it up, full, around off. Alyssa Healy dances down the pitch and lifts it just over the leaping fielder at mid off for a boundary.
Loopy delivery again, full, around off. Rachael Haynes advances down the track and knocks it to long off for a single.
Tosses it up, full, and on middle. Rachael Haynes steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Rachael Haynes stays in her crease and guides it towards third man. Single taken!
Outside off, tad fuller. Rachael Haynes defends it out off the front foot.
Fraction shorter this time, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes steers it towards third man for a single.
Angling in around middle and leg, on a length. Alyssa Healy works it away towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
On a length, width on offer. Rachael Haynes stays in her crease and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Katherine Brunt (4-0-17-0) is back into the attack.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Alyssa Healy makes room and pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Angling in on the pads, on a length. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Wide of off, shorter ball. Rachael Haynes cuts it towards point. No run there!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it past point for a single.
FOUR! Edgy runs! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Alyssa Healy looks to heave this over on the leg side, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.

FOUR! Crunched! Fraction shorter ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary. She brings up her fifty in style! Another fine knock from another fine player. Both the openers making most of the dropped catch.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Alyssa Healy leans and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around off. Rachael Haynes drives it towards long off for a single.
Very full and around off. Haynes skips down and lofts it over mid on for an easy couple of runs. Australia changing the gears now.
Flatter and on middle, flicked to square leg for a single. 100 up for Australia Women.
Slides a length ball, around middle and leg. Healy gets low as she sweeps it to fine leg for a couple of runs. A shout for LBW but there was some bat on it.
Angles a full ball, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, on a length. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover for a single.

Another length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes steers it towards third man. Fifty for Rachael Haynes! What a World Cup she is having! Another fine knock from her. Fifty in semi-final and now in final. Big game player...

PUT DOWN! Another chance goes down! This is can prove to be costly! A shorter ball, on middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver there moves to her right, and gets her hands to it, but she fails to hold on to it. Another single taken!
Outside off, on a length. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards third man for a single.
Fraction shorter now, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it toward deep square leg for a single.

DROPPED! First chance and it is gone down! A shorter ball, wide of off, Rachael Haynes cuts it towards Danni Wyatt at backward point. She gets low to her left, gets her hands to it, but fails to grab it. Single taken!
Three runs taken! All things working in favour of Australia so far! Tad short and just outside off. Haynes cuts it late and past backward point for three runs.
Tossed up, on off. Healy sweeps it in front of square leg for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
Flatter and given flight to this one. This one keeps coming with the angle. Haynes tries to dab it away but gets cramp for room and hits it past the keeper for a single.
Quicker, shorter and turning around middle. Haynes works it to square leg.
An arm ball, sliding around leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, short of a length this time. Healy knocks it to backward point and ends the over with a single.
Length ball, around the 4th stump channel. Haynes chops it to point for a single.
Wide! Bit of swing there but the line was on the leg side. A wide given.
Overpitched and outside off. Haynes drives it hard but straight to the point fielder.
Outside off. Alyssa hits it past point for a run.
Length ball, well outside off. Healy flashes it to covers.
Slightly short and on off. Haynes shuffles and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Full and on off, Healy drives it on the front foot to covers.
Slower now, flighted and on off. Defended out.
FOUR! Pummeled! Tossed up, on middle, quicker this one. Healy makes room and hammers it well over mid off for a boundary.
Too full and on middle, swept to deep backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Haynes rocks back and flicks it to square leg.
Flighted, full from 'round the wicket, on middle. Haynes blocks it out.

DRINKS! It's been all Australia at the moment. They have not given away anything yet, they tackled the swing well initially and put away the bad deliveries. But, England have just got their spinners in, and England will hope Sophie Ecclestone can break this opening partnership.
Length ball, on middle and hint of swing there. Haynes tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Pitches it up, on middle. Haynes blocks it back to the bowler.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Haynes misses her flick.
Overpitched and on the pads. Healy bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for an easy single.
On a length and outside off. Healy opens the face of her bat and steers it to third man for a single.
Touch fuller and on middle, Haynes works it to square leg for a single.
Kate Cross comes into the attack.
Tossed up, on middle, pushed to mid on.
Around off. Blocked out.
Flatter and straying on the pads. Healy looks to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge to point.

Sophie Ecclestone convinces Knight to take an LBW decision upstairs. UltraEdge shows there was an inside edge and England burn their review. This was full and angling around middle and leg. Healy seems to miss her flick. There was an appeal for LBW but not given. England take the review but there was a thick inside edge. Not out it is.
Floated, full and angling around off. Haynes paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Healy drops it to cover and takes off for a quick single.
Shorter now, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Much fuller now, outside off. Rachael Haynes drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Another length delivery, around middle and leg. Rachael Haynes works it away towards mid-wicket.
Angling in around middle, on a length. Alyssa Healy tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy defends it towards cover.
On a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy punches it past the diving fielder at mid on for a brace.
FOUR! Classy! Another fuller delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes dances down the pitch and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around off. Rachael Haynes advances down the pitch and pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Cut away! Short, wide of off. Rachael Haynes hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.
Fuller ball, loopy delivery, around middle. Rachael Haynes advances down the pitch and pushes it towards mid off.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Alyssa Healy steps down the pitch and knocks it to long on for a single.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy punches it towards point for a single.
Another full ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes steers it towards third man for another single.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy guides it towards third and rotates the strike.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy clips it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Single taken!
Angling in around middle, on a length. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards square leg for a single. 50 up for Australia Women!
Loopy delivery, full, around middle. Rachael Haynes lunges and blocks it out.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy comes down the pitch again and knocks it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! A fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Alyssa Healy steps down the pitch and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
A low full toss, darting it on the pads. Rachael Haynes works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Rachael Haynes flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Spin for the first time as Charlotte Dean is into the attack.
Charlotte Dean begins with a loopy ball, very full, around middle. Alyssa Healy steps down and drives it past cover for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Rachael Haynes defends it out.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Rachael Haynes taps it towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Rachael Haynes leaves it alone.
FOUR! Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Another length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end. A better throw at the keeper's end would have been curtains for Rachael Haynes!
On a length, around off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards cover.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Fuller and slanting way outside off. Haynes shoulders arms to it.
Length ball, outside off at 99 clicks. Haynes is happy to let it through to the keeper.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely driven! This is full and angling on middle. Healy drives it to the left of mid on and beats the fielder there easily to find the fence. Healy finding her groove now.
Shape there again, on middle, it is tucked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, swinging back in, around off. Healy keeps it out.
Length ball, around off, steep bounce this time. Healy defends from the higher part of the blade.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! This is too straight, full and on the pads. Healy flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tad short and on middle, does not bounce much. Haynes gets low as she pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, on off. Haynes defends it towards cover.
Around off, on a length, this is hit to point.
Length ball, way outside off. Haynes taps it to point.
Natalie Sciver comes into the attack.
Too full and around off, pushed to mid off.
Fuller ball, swinging away from the left-hander. Haynes pushes it softly to mid off and takes a quick single.
Length and outside off. Left alone.
Anya Shrubsole is getting the ball to swing as she serves an outswinger, on a length and around off. Haynes defends it on the deck.
This one swings across but was on a length. Haynes watchfully leaves it.
Outside off, on a length. Haynes shoulders arms to it.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off at 111 kph. Haynes thinks of defending this but tries to withdraw her bat too late. It takes the bottom edge and goes to first slip, on a bounce.
Length ball, angling across, outside off. Haynes leaves it alone.
FOUR! Yet another short ball, on middle and Haynes pulls it nicely and past square leg for a boundary.
Full ball, on off. Rachael blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length, on middle. Haynes hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but not given! A full ball, swinging back in, around middle. Healy looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The late swing might just angle it down the leg side.
Touch fuller and on off, pushed nicely but straight to the fielder at mid on.
Length ball, outside off and a hint of inward shape. Healy defends it out.
Leg bye! Length ball, slanting on the pads. Haynes misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and the batters take a leg bye.
Wide! Full ball, slower but down the leg side. Haynes misses her flick.
Angles a length ball from around the wicket, around off. Haynes gets behind the line and blocks it.
On a length and on off. Haynes defends it towards point.
Full in length, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards mid on.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Fuller now, swinging in, around middle. Rachael Haynes flicks it towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! A beauty by Katherine Brunt! Swinging it away this time, outside off, on a length. Rachael Haynes hangs back and tries to block this but she gets beaten on the outside edge.

Leg bye! Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy looks to flick but she misses. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters steal a leg bye. There was half an appeal for LBW, but not given!
Tad shorter now, around middle. Rachael Haynes swivels and pulls it towards the fielder at fine leg. Single taken!
Full in length, tailing back in outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and blocks it out.
Swinging in around off, fuller in length. Alyssa Healy drives it towards the fielder at cover.
On a length, down the leg side. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery, shaping away, around middle. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.
Another length ball, swinging away, around off. Rachael Haynes defends it out.
On a length, shaping away, around off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards cover.
Much fuller now, around off. Alyssa Healy drives it towards cover.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point.
FOUR! Crunched! First boundary for Alyssa Healy. Shorter and wide of off. Alyssa Healy hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards mid on.
Another length delivery, shaping away, around off. Alyssa Healy blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and defends it out.
Change of angle for Anya Shrubsole this time! She goes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes leaves it alone.
Swinging away, outside off, another length delivery. Rachael Haynes stays in her crease and taps it towards cover.
An outswinger, outside off, on a length. Rachael Haynes leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.

FOUR! First boundary of the match! On a length, down the leg side. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg. Brunt runs to her left, puts in a dive but fails to keep the ball away from the ropes. Boundary!
Anya Shrubsole begins with a length ball, shaping away, around middle. Rachael Haynes defends it out solidly.
Who will start from the other end? It is Anya Shrubsole. Two slips in place...
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy leans forward and defends it out. Good start for Brunt, 2 runs the over.
On a length, angling in on the pads. Rachael Haynes tucks it towards fine leg for a single. She gets off the mark!

Much fuller on this occasion, around middle. Alyssa Healy looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge past gully towards third man for a single. Alyssa Healy and Australia Women are up and running!
Good-length delivery, shaping away outside off. Alyssa Healy leaves it alone.
Beaten! Fuller this time, swinging away, outside off Alyssa Healy leans to block this but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Katherine Brunt begins with a length ball, shaping away outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover off the back foot.

All set for the game to begin. England Women are near the ropes, in a huddle for one last pep talk before they stride out. Australia too, have their full staff in a huddle as they wait for their openers, Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes. We have the speedster, Mitchell Starc in attendance too. England take a knee while Australia stand in solidarity to support the 'BLM' movement. Let's play....

We are moments away from the action. Hagley Oval, Christchurch is packed and set up perfectly for the finals. Both the teams, Australia Women and England Women stride out and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be England first, followed by Australia.

Anya Shrubsole is up for a quick chat. She says that she was bowling terribly at the start, but she loves semi-finals and finals. Adds that she wanted the team to get on a start and she was lucky to get two wickets early in the semi-final. Mentions it's important to have bowling partnerships and Katherine Brunt did a massive job in the previous game. States that it was great to see the batters put around 290 on the board, and Danni Wyatt and Sophia Dunkley were terrific in the semi-final.

PITCH REPORT - Anjum Chopra says the ground is bigger on one side so, the batters will look for quick runs. Lisa Sthalekar joins her and says Sophie Ecclestone is the best bowler in the world and she will look to slow her pace as there is a good amount of grass and there will be a bit of spin. Hopefully a good game ahead.

Meg Lanning, the captain of Australia Women, says they have batted first many times so they are happy with it. Adds Ellyse Perry is a world class player and it gives a big boost today as she averages around 50 with the bat. Tells that they have played some good cricket for a number of years but it will be nice to finish on a good note.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says that they will bowl first, it's a fresh wicket and they want to make use of it with the new ball. Mentions that they have bowled here well and they did bat well also, they know the conditions here. Adds that it's been a remarkable run for this team, and they have been playing knock-out cricket in their last five games and hopefully they can do the same and lift the trophy.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Rachael Haynes, Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry (In for Annabel Sutherland), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Alana King, Jess Jonassen, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

England Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Charlotte Dean, Kate Cross, Anya Shrubsole.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of England Women. They have elected to BOWL first!

Beth Mooney is down for a chat. She says England has shown their consistency, they have world-class players, Sophie Ecclestone has shown her class and they are not taking them lightly. Adds that they have played a lot against them and they have their plans. Mentions that she has an easy job in the team because the girls at the top order are doing most of the work.

The last time these two sides met in this tournament we witnessed a nail-biter, with Australia eventually coming out on top. But with England playing at their best, this proves to be another mouth-watering contest. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

It’s been an exceptional turnaround from England Women. After losing their first three games, they have fought their back and have made it all the way to the final. Every game for them since their last defeat has been a do-or-die encounter, and they started playing their best cricket at the right time. England spinners Sophie Ecclestone and Charlotte Dean have been probably been their best players, they have grabbed wickets and have not allowed the batters to score freely. England will be riding high on confidence and will want to put their best foot forward to try to defend their crown.

The six-time world champions, Australia Women have been the best team in the tournament, they have won all their games so far and have been very dominant. Their top 4 batters have been in sublime form they have scored most of the runs in this tournament and they will look to carry on the same way. However, Ellyse Perry will probably not be a part of the playing XI, however, if she does, it will only strengthen their squad. Australia Women have not played a game at Hagley Oval till now, and they will have to adapt to the conditions quickly. That should not really concern them considering the form they are in. Australia will try to execute their plans and come out on top to lift the World Cup for the seventh time.

After 28 league matches and two semi-finals, it all comes down to one final game in this exuberant tournament, the ICC Women’s World Cup 2022. It will be the unbeaten side in this tournament, Australia Women up against the defending champions, England Women in the final of this World Cup at the Hagley Oval, Christchurch. Both teams have won their semi-final games convincingly and now they fight one last time for the big prize. On that note, welcome to our coverage.
